pull_requests.body:
## Scope

- integrate the existing zero-cost logical PostgreSQL backup workflow onto the current default-branch lineage
- retain the PostgreSQL 17 disposable restore verification, age encryption, manifest, static QA, helper script, and runbook
- include the LF normalization required for Linux execution
- select the owner-authorized **Single-owner Option A** operating model

## Selected owner model: Single-owner Option A

The repository has one authorized owner and no independent second GitHub reviewer. The `lari-staging-backup` environment must therefore have **no required reviewer** and must not use Prevent self-review. Automated or AI technical review is not represented as independent human approval.

This is an explicit security limitation: there is no independent human authorization. The owner must authorize these as three separate actions:

1. merge this PR;
2. dispatch each backup after checking the ref, inputs, and environment;
3. authorize any later P0 migration only after reviewing a recoverable backup and restore evidence.

No one action authorizes either of the others.

## GitHub environment setup

In **Repository Settings > Environments**, create or update `lari-staging-backup`:

- leave **Required reviewers** disabled with no reviewers;
- under **Deployment branches and tags**, choose **Selected branches and tags**;
- permit exactly `staging/supabase-staging-consistency`;
- add no wildcard, tag, or additional branch rule;
- retain the existing repository-scoped secret `STAGING_DB_PASSWORD`; do not reveal, retrieve, copy, rotate, or reset it for this workflow;
- retain `LARI_STAGING_POOLER_HOST` as an environment variable containing only the exact Supabase Session Pooler hostname;
- retain `LARI_BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT` as an environment secret containing only the operator-owned age X25519 public recipient;
- do not duplicate the age recipient at repository or organization scope;
- keep the age private identity entirely offline and outside GitHub.

Never place secret values in the PR, issue comments, repository files, or workflow logs.

## Preserved workflow gates

- `workflow_dispatch` is the only trigger; there is no push, pull-request, schedule, or repository-dispatch trigger
- exact source project: `rwedeejhjazwjthdjzrt`
- exact confirmation: `BACKUP rwedeejhjazwjthdjzrt`
- exact default ref: `refs/heads/staging/supabase-staging-consistency`
- single-run concurrency with no cancellation of an active backup
- 30-minute timeout
- PostgreSQL 17.6 disposable restore verification
- age encryption before upload
- encrypted backup plus non-sensitive manifest only
- failed restore verdicts remove upload candidates and cannot satisfy the upload condition
- offline private decryption key

Static qualification: **PASS**  
Remote database connections attempted by static qualification: **0**

## Vercel production gate before merge

Current project evidence shows that `staging/supabase-staging-consistency` has production-target deployment history. A workflow-only merge can still create a Vercel production deployment and update production aliases.

Before authorizing merge, protect the production aliases using one explicit Vercel control:

- in **Project Settings > Environments > Production > Branch Tracking**, move Production tracking away from `staging/supabase-staging-consistency` to an owner-controlled quarantine branch that will not receive the merge; **or**
- in **Project Settings > Git > Connected Git Repository**, disconnect the repository.

Read the setting back and verify that the merge cannot create a production-target deployment or move a production/custom-domain alias. Restoring Production Branch tracking or reconnecting Git requires a separate production authorization after the merge is verified.

## Current status

- this PR remains **Draft**
- backup dispatched: **NO**
- GitHub environment non-secret controls read back: **no required reviewer; exact branch only**
- protected configuration names read back: repository secret `STAGING_DB_PASSWORD`; environment variable `LARI_STAGING_POOLER_HOST`; environment secret `LARI_BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT`
- protected values inspected or disclosed by this work: **NO**
- Supabase database writes: **NO**
- P0 migration applied: **NO**
- production deployment authorized: **NO**
